reviews.review_title: Very detailed game with lots of passion
reviews.review_description: I don’t usually see games like these but I personally think this is a gem unfortunately not popular. I could go on and on and on about how great this game is. Only problem is that there isn’t much to do other then horror. In no way am I hating it but I’m saying what needs to be said. This isn’t glazing the game, it’s a honest review as a moderator.

Has a lot of content and gets a lot of updates

developer_response.body: Wow! I'm surprised someone found this game! Little hint for ya... The levers in Level 1 are in order so ya gotta find one, which unlocks another, which unlocks ANOTHER, and then unlocks yet another to finally unlock the red exit lever at the door. Hope this helps!
